# WebGL generated-wrapper family: 3816 checked members and nine shared behavior relationships

This adds source-read behavior to existing Firefox structural maps at revision `1a097ed8d31f6b307a5d0ebc34a82ceaf7f3727b` in repository `git:314d8065c5ad68c7e5c5f92d`. It preserves those earlier maps. The family has **3,816 generated wrappers**, **2,933 distinct target paths**, **93 manifests**, and one generated build file. The parent build also includes the generated directory. The wrappers contain HTML; their shared harness and imported helpers contain JavaScript; the generator uses Python; manifests use TOML. The browser runtime is Mochitest.

## Existing evidence and added coverage

Existing maps already list [shared JavaScript declarations](843f44bd-6af8-4891-8e66-c1fea48e9c43.md), [Python generator declarations](3cae1139-8f96-4ddb-8da0-ed25713401b8.md), and [unresolved state-write sites](d70e7c9a-3b22-4bf2-838a-8546d235fce3.md). These records come from the same source and are not independent confirmations. This contribution adds checked receiver relationships, implementation effects, completion behavior, and distinct test-link classes. It does not rewrite the structural records.

## Shared behavior chain

Generated wrapper → `mochi-single` → preference callback → target navigation → imported result helper → outer assertions → target completion → `SimpleTest.finish` cleanup and runner notification. The SpecialPowers injected-object binding and some outer-runner consumers remain unresolved.

- [WebGL wrapper generation binds target paths and WebGL versions](9fa236b5-665a-4a46-a430-c668abb00e2a.md) — `generator-bindings`, `observed`.
- [WebGL wrapper starts target navigation from the preference callback](366a9419-4a2f-47ba-994d-b38e47b12050.md) — `preference-trigger`, `observed`.
- [SpecialPowersChild.pushPrefEnv completion and the WebGL binding gap](06666c73-c3ac-40b2-8b60-bef7dd3fb667.md) — `pref-callback-contract`, `observed-body-with-binding-gap`.
- [WebGL conformance results flow from the target to the outer assertion harness](24728fb4-8634-4c93-b00d-c7d5626dfd47.md) — `result-forwarding`, `observed`.
- [Inactive-attribute WebGL test enters the shared harness through its script dependencies](09ff632c-c5e0-445c-a5de-440fb21349eb.md) — `target-integration`, `observed`.
- [finishTest appends the WebGL postlude without waiting for script loading](263d982c-1ea6-49a1-bbe7-d92f6bc72918.md) — `dynamic-postlude`, `observed`.
- [WebGL postlude forwards completion and reports duplicate notification](7987fc54-c98a-42ef-aa4c-527e93c55845.md) — `postlude-and-notify`, `observed`.
- [SimpleTest.finish starts cleanup before notifying test-complete](5c5e6061-14c5-4835-8234-a0ea69c46757.md) — `simpletest-completion`, `observed-scoped-body`.
- [WebGL always-fail test directly checks expected-failure forwarding](3a5b3b5d-3324-4080-9187-3196bf4a7aed.md) — `direct-failure-sentinel`, `observed`.

## Checked family bindings

The automated check compared each complete wrapper against the shared template after substituting the actual target and version. It checked every wrapper and target Git object against the pinned tree. It checked exactly one manifest membership per wrapper and registration in the generated build file. It retained the raw manifest defaults and per-test fields separately. An independent checker review compared these identities against the pinned Git tree and read the generator, template, failure sentinel, and parent build registration.

All 3,816 wrappers passed these mechanical checks: 966 WebGL1 wrappers and 2,850 WebGL2 wrappers. The automated check read 3,911 blobs, 2,565,362 bytes, and took 3.070862333988771 seconds. That duration excludes source explanation, independent review, and publication. It is not an end-to-end ingestion speed.

Exact source anchors:

- [Generator, `WriteWrapper` and `WriteWrappers`, lines 318–366](https://github.com/mozilla-firefox/firefox/blob/1a097ed8d31f6b307a5d0ebc34a82ceaf7f3727b/dom/canvas/test/webgl-conf/generate-wrappers-and-manifest.py#L318-L366).
- [Wrapper dependencies and iframe, lines 11–15](https://github.com/mozilla-firefox/firefox/blob/1a097ed8d31f6b307a5d0ebc34a82ceaf7f3727b/dom/canvas/test/webgl-conf/mochi-wrapper.html.template#L11-L15).
- [Parent build registration, lines 39–41](https://github.com/mozilla-firefox/firefox/blob/1a097ed8d31f6b307a5d0ebc34a82ceaf7f3727b/dom/canvas/moz.build#L39-L41): `DIRS += [` followed by `"test/webgl-conf/generated",`.

The sentinel deliberately resolves `checkout/../always-fail.html` to `dom/canvas/test/webgl-conf/always-fail.html`. A rule that requires every target to stay under `checkout/` would incorrectly reject this member.

## Reuse boundary and remaining work

The shared implementation can be read once while each wrapper retains its own target, WebGL version, Git object identity, manifest entry, raw defaults, raw overrides, and source links. These per-member facts are durable evidence. An optional search index can be rebuilt from them.

The 2,933 target paths still have separate function-body, assertions, imported-helper-version, and production-code obligations. A matching template does not establish their behavior. Manifest merge rules and platform conditions were not evaluated. The generator and product tests were not run. No runtime pass/fail is claimed.

- Every underlying target body and its actual harness version/call sites remain to be checked; the one representative cannot establish all target consumers.
- SpecialPowers injection/binding, PushPrefEnv parent receiver and normal test-runner preference cleanup remain external contract gaps.
- Parent ok alias/assertion internals, parentRunner.testFinished, timeout/error handlers and frame release are not fully followed.
- A dedicated expected-failure harness sentinel exists in always-fail.html with fail-if=true. Other forwarding details, duplicate completion, asynchronous cleanup and preference restoration are not directly asserted by this sentinel.
- No product tests were run. No recorded pass/fail is inferred from source.
- No Thunderbird-to-Firefox call chain was analyzed in this shared Firefox harness slice.

This is source evidence for a bounded family. It adds no development rule and does not establish full-file or full-repository behavioral completion.

## Reproduce the membership check

The [standalone verifier and usage instructions](https://github.com/arschmitz/tb-tools/blob/84535b6076726841c50aef35379db56edfda9f66/docs/knowledge-ingestion-webgl-family.md) are published in tb-tools at `84535b6076726841c50aef35379db56edfda9f66`. It reads local pinned Git objects with lazy fetching disabled. It does not execute the source generator.

The final verifier passed six fixture tests and checked all 3,816 wrappers against Firefox revision `1a097ed8d31f6b307a5d0ebc34a82ceaf7f3727b` on macOS with Python 3.14.6. The check finished at `2026-10-14T01:33:40.579278+00:00` and took 2.003692416008562 seconds. It read 3,912 blobs, including the generator. This is a separate mechanical verification run; it does not replace the earlier timing or measure explanation, review, or publication speed. No Firefox product tests ran.
